Preview review (proxy for epic:#26676#1) · 18318361f74f8b1d1623f333efa9216bbd3a7170 · PASS

Run under ruling 6520722066 on #26676, after the merge. One context-free reviewer was given only the card's Acceptance section, the v4 boards (a7825499), the "What to look at" list of 6514502858, and the console. It drove the console with Playwright on `main` at the sha above, on `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, seeded admin), at 1600x1000. Screenshots are on the never-merged branch `claude/issue-27604-proxy-evidence` (043aa531), folder `evidence/27604-proxy/`.

Stand-ins for HotCRM's objects: Account declares `highlightFields` [status, industry, annual_revenue]; User declares [name, email, email_verified], which is the name-field case; Contact (has a `stage` select) and Project (has status and health) declare none.

**1. Hover or Space shows the card on every surface: PASS.**
- Checked on a list relation cell (Account in Projects, Project in Tasks), an enlarged table cell (Team → Memberships, Product → Invoice Lines), a details-column lookup (single, multi-lookup chips, master-detail, Owner), and a compact related row in the split pane (Account → Contacts, Field Zoo).
- No card at 370 ms, card at 450–480 ms; a 200 ms pass-through opens nothing.
- Space on the focused reference shows the card without navigating or clicking the row. Esc closes it and keeps the enlarged view open. Pointer-out and Tab close it. A second reference replaces the first card.
- Bounding boxes of the table, row and chip, and the document's scroll size, are the same before and after.
- Shots: [list cell](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-list-cell-account.png), [list cell, Space](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-list-cell-space.png), [enlarged, Owner](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-enlarged-team-dev-admin.png), [enlarged, Project](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-enlarged-team-website-relaunch.png), [enlarged, Invoice](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-enlarged-product-inv-1003.png), [details lookup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-details-lookup-account.png), [multi-lookup chip](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-details-multilookup-chip.png), [master-detail](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-details-masterdetail-project.png), [related row](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-related-row-contact.png), [related row, Space](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-related-row-space.png), [one card at a time](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-one-card-at-a-time.png).

**2. What the card draws: PASS.**
- Account shows Lifecycle, Industry and Annual Revenue in declared order, with option chips and currency.
- User shows Email and Email Verified; the declared `name` is not repeated as a row.
- Contact, Project, Invoice, Field Zoo and Membership cards show the name and the object label only. The contact card shows no stage, and the project card no status or health.
- Not exercisable here: a field the reader cannot read (the only sign-in is admin), and the cap of 6 (no showcase object declares more than 4).
- Shots: [Owner → User](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-details-owner-user.png), [Project, no highlights](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-list-cell-project-nohighlights.png), plus the account and related-row shots above.

**3. Requests: PASS.**
- Lists (Projects, Tasks, Invoices, Contacts, Field Zoo), record pages and enlarged tables fired only their own queries on render, with no per-reference read, even with 64 record links on a page.
- Each card shown fired exactly one read. A re-hover, or the same record later on another view, fired none.
- After Northwind's Industry was edited from Retail to Finance on its record page, the next hover on Projects fired one new read and showed Finance. It was set back afterwards.
- Shot: [card after the change](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/043aa531/evidence/27604-proxy/27604-proxy-cache-after-change.png).

**Notes, not REWORK.**
- Space does nothing while only the grid cell (`td`, tabindex 0) holds focus; it works once Tab reaches the link inside the cell.
- For a target object with lookup fields, the single read is `?top=1&filter=[id=…]&populate=…` and populates every lookup on the target, system ones included, though the card draws none of them. It is still one request per card.
- The record page itself differs from the v4 boards in places (no tab row, a text Timeline | Related column toggle, the enlarged view as a "‹ Back" sub-view). None of these bears on this card; the boards do not draw the hover card.
